title: Dealing with Anger and Anxiety: Tools for the Child and the Parent
summary: Recurring tantrums, intense anxiety, or a mood that is disturbed most of the day—these are signs that require intervention. Teach your child to name their feelings ("I am angry"), a breathing technique, and when to ask for help.
try_this: Create a "Calm Box" together: paper, pens, a stress ball, soothing pictures. When they are angry, go to the box together, choose a tool, then talk after 10 minutes: What happened?
reflection_prompts: How many times was the box used this week?
